description: What the Control API answers for a device's reports: each case gives the `reported` section of the device's named shadows (stream, net, gps; absent means no shadow), a read request, and the response. Recorded from helios-cloud's Control API (2026-11-27) with no settings kept in the cloud, so `desired` is what the device reports. A device that serves the same API itself (LLD 13) must give the same status, error type and, for 200, the same body. Error messages aren't compared, so they're left out. Fields that come from the shadow's metadata (reportedAt) aren't in these cases: a device may add them. {deviceId} stands for the device's own ID; other path parameters are in params.
